requirements.statement: No environment or setup check stops, pauses or asks before implementation starts or continues. Every problem is recorded as a flag with a stated default, the build runs in full, and the flag appears in the readout. (Source: investigation doc, owner instruction 2026-10-23; the TRD's Source PRD is the investigation doc, no separate PRD file exists.)

Before each verification attempt, the loop checks that the running build is the current HEAD and that no other checkout holds the dev stack. A failed check is reported as a setup failure naming the problem: the attempt is not judged, nothing is sent to the debugger, and it never counts toward stalled.

A verification run whose environment stays broken ends with a distinct outcome, setup-failure, that names what is wrong and what would fix it. It is never reported as stalled or stuck, and the run's banner and report say it is the environment, not the code.
At plan time, the TRD records which environment verification runs against, whether the loop can refresh it, and what cannot be checked there.
The setup check never runs a refresh against a stack another checkout holds.
Code changed by this work ships with unit tests at the constitution floor: unit >= 60%, integration >= 50% where applicable.
